effective.basis: Old state: UDE official card rulings (Sangan/Witch: 'If you have no eligible monsters, your opponent gets to see your Deck to verify', captured 2005-06-16) through Konami's own per-set rulings documents - Machina Mayhem (2010-04-06, 18 days before the Edison snapshot), Starstrike Blast (2010-11-16), Storm of Ragnarok (2011-02-02). New state: KDE-US Tournament Policy section 'Card/Hand/Deck Verification' forbids verifying the opponent's Deck (first located capture 2019-04-03; still current in v2.5, 2025-09-05). No dated announcement of the change was found, so the interval 2011-02-02 .. 2019-04-03 stays open.

changes.historical_text: FLIP: Select 1 Equip Spell Card from your Deck and add it to your hand.
changes.summary: Period procedure only, not a text erratum: the sole difference between goat/c504700120.lua and official/c73431236.lua is `else Duel.GoatConfirm(tp,LOCATION_DECK)` on the FLIP effect's failed search - if no Equip Spell is found the goat script reveals the Deck, the modern script does nothing. The activation condition is unchanged: `s.target` returns true unconditionally in BOTH scripts, because a FLIP effect is mandatory and always resolves, so this card carries the verification procedure alone and no relaxed activation semantics. That places it squarely under the shared search-verification chronology.

review.notes: Verified by reading both full scripts: they are line-for-line identical apart from the added else-branch. Text lineage v0 (DCR-064, 2003-12-01) -> v1 (DL12-EN006, 2011-06-01) -> v2 (SBSC-EN034, 2019-08-01) is cosmetic: "Select 1 Equip Spell Card from your Deck and add it to your hand" -> "Add 1 Equip Spell Card from your Deck to your hand" -> "Add 1 Equip Spell from your Deck to your hand". No behavioural text transition, hence modern_text_version null. Because the difference is purely the verification procedure, both GOAT (2005-04-01) and Edison (2010-04-24) fall determinately in the old era and need this historical implementation.
